alternatives.reason_rejected: reads as a git range; ambiguous against the scope revision
chose the shorter `@` prefix for the same meaning; 'at' was already taken by observed_at on the same line

context: Working-set revision rendering changed to self-labelling tokens: base..head for a range, @head for a single commit, since base for an open base; scope line says 'revision <token>', observed line says 'over <range>'.
rationale: Review finding: in git syntax `..X` means `HEAD..X`, a range, while src/contracts/scope.ts binds a head-only revision to exactly one commit, so the old form mis-stated what a ruling was bound to; and the observed line's range was unlabelled beside a differently-valued scope revision in the same chunk. `@head` reads as one commit, `since base` as open-ended, and `over` names what the check ran across versus what the record is bound to. Tests pin all three forms and the two-ranges-in-one-chunk case.
summary: Chose revision tokens `base..head` / `@head` / `since base` with `revision <token>` on the scope line and `over <range>` on the observed line, replacing the `..head` / `base..` forms
